intro.text: Ohhh... hello... traveller. I am... Ollo. I sell... things. Slowly. I have been... on my way... to this crossing... since the spring before last.

beetles.text: Crystal Beetles... keep eating... my wares. Tonics. Scrolls. One ate... my hat. I would chase them... but I would arrive... next week. Could you... persuade three of them... to stop?

accepted.text: Wonderful... They nest by the crystals... east of the lake... and in the shadows... northwest. Mind the mandibles. They chime... before they bite.

greet.text: Ohhh... it's you again. How... nice. Did you know... I've moved... almost a whole shell-length... since we last spoke?

progress.text: Still... crunching. I can hear them... from here. East of the lake... and northwest. Three of them... and I'll give you... my lucky ring.

journey.text: To Sporehaven... the village beyond the northern gate. My cousin... lives there. I'll arrive... in time for... his grandchildren's... grandchildren. It's important... to have... goals.

thanks.text: Ohhh... the crunching... has stopped. Bless you. Take my lucky ring. It was... very lucky. Until the beetles. Now it's... your luck.

options.text: Thanks, Ollo. And browse your shop?
